main_text.p: inclusiuè sumto, hoc est die Mercurij obseruatio-nem Ptolemæi incidisse: quandoquidem vera epocha Chrifti cœpit die folis. Quod autem ad fixam Chrifti æram attinet, qua ponitur principium annorum Chrifti incidisse in meridiem fabbati, kal. Ian. anni 46 Iuliani, diximus antea eam diem fabbati re-ipsa conuenire cum die folis: cùm aftronomi posuerint annum tertium Chrifti fuisse intercalarem, qui tamen fuit fimplex, vt apparet ex vera annorum Iulianorum dispositione: hinc factum est, vt dies, quam visi sunt in epocha Chrifti anticipasse, in suum locum sit restituta: & interualla omnia iusta habeatur. Quare mendum est in epitome Regiomontani lib. 3 Almagesti propof. 21, quando scribitur cõsiderationem Ptolemæi fuisse post principium annorum Chrifti interiectis annis Ægyptiis 131, diebus 301, cum horis duabus.
main_text.l: Anni Iul. | Lit.dom. Nabonafari. | Feriæ. | Chrifti.

page.notes: The Iulian-day column entries 19, 18, 17 and 16 Iul. are printed beside the Feriae column and are set against the rows where they stand; their placement is taken from the scan. The Chrifti column ends with 199 on its own line below 153. Doubtful: the printed hyphen at "obseruatio-nem" and at "re-ipsa" is kept as shown. The word after "fixam" is not clearly legible in the scan; "fixam" is a best reading. The numbers 131 and 301 are printed with spacing between digits and are given here as single numbers.
